About the job

Job summary

This position is based nationally.

Job description

Job Title

Project Manager

Group Profile

ISD - Information Services Division within the Security and Information Directorate (SID)

Business Design, Development and Deployment (BD3)

Grade

Senior Executive Officer (SEO)

Overview of Security and Information Directorate (SID)

Security and information management are fundamental to enabling the Ministry of Justice to deliver its services. SID brings together specialist teams that help the department manage information securely, lawfully and transparently.

We identify, manage and mitigate security, data protection and information risks, and provide assurance against those risks. We work across the Ministry of Justice, its agencies, the Government Security Group, the Government Knowledge and Information Management profession and other partners.

We also support improvement and change where better information, technology, processes and ways of working can improve outcomes for the department and its users.

Team Profile

Information Services Division is responsible for ensuring the MoJ:

• Manages its information so that it knows what is held and where it is held - Knowledge management and Records management

• Holds its information in compliance with legislation and is accessible - Data protection and freedom of information

• Is clear who owns the information and that they understand their responsibilities - Knowledge management

• Holds its information securely - Information assurance

Business Design, Development and Deployment (BD3)

The Business Design, Development and Deployment team, known as BD3, turn the Information Services Division and departmental priorities into planned and controlled delivery.

We provide project, change and service improvement capability across a varied portfolio.

Our work includes records and information management, subject access requests, redaction, public inquiries, information security and digital services. Projects range from improving existing processes to developing digital solutions, supporting procurement, and implementing wider departmental change.

We work with operational teams, subject matter experts, digital and technology colleagues, commercial, finance and legal teams, senior leaders, suppliers and other government organisations. The team also supports portfolio planning so that new work can be prioritised against capacity, dependencies and expected benefits.

Summary

The Project Manager will lead the delivery of projects and significant workstreams within the BD3 portfolio, from initial definition and planning through to implementation, transition and closure.

You will bring structure to complex work, maintain delivery momentum and make sure scope, plans, risks, dependencies, decisions and outcomes are clear. You will work across a changing portfolio and will need to build effective relationships with colleagues at all levels.

You will provide clear and reliable information to senior leaders and governance forums so that decisions can be made quickly and on the basis of good evidence.

Responsibilities, Activities and Duties

The postholder will be expected to:

• Lead the delivery of projects or significant workstreams, taking responsibility for agreed outcomes, timescales and priorities.

• Define project scope, objectives, deliverables and success measures with project sponsors, stakeholders and subject matter experts.

• Develop and maintain clear delivery plans, including milestones, resources, risks, issues and dependencies.

• Establish proportionate governance and provide clear, accurate reporting to senior leaders and decision-making forums.

• Build effective relationships across organisational boundaries, bringing together operational teams, policy, digital, commercial, finance, legal and other specialist colleagues as required.

• Work with subject matter experts and users to understand requirements, identify practical solutions and support effective decision-making.

• Manage changes to scope and priorities, assessing the impact on delivery and escalating where appropriate.

• Support business cases, options appraisals, procurement activity and supplier engagement where required.

• Ensure projects are prepared for implementation, including business readiness, communications, training, adoption and handover into business-as-usual arrangements.

• Track delivery against intended outcomes and benefits, identifying barriers and taking action to maintain progress.

• Contribute to BD3 portfolio planning, prioritisation and continuous improvement of project delivery approaches, reporting and tools.

• Provide day-to-day leadership to colleagues working on projects and, depending on business need, undertake line management responsibilities.

This list reflects the current requirements of the role and is not intended to be exhaustive. The postholder may be asked to undertake other duties appropriate to the grade as priorities and the portfolio develop.

Essential skills

• Experience of successfully managing projects or significant workstreams from planning through to implementation, with personal responsibility for delivery.

• Strong planning and control skills, with the ability to develop realistic delivery plans, manage milestones and dependencies, and keep work on track when circumstances or priorities change.

• Experience of identifying, assessing and managing project risks and issues, including knowing when and how to escalate them.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credible relationships and bring together people with different priorities, perspectives and areas of expertise.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex information clearly and provide concise updates and recommendations to senior colleagues.

• Sound judgement and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse information, identify practical options and use evidence to support decisions.

• Ability to manage competing priorities, maintain momentum and deliver high-quality work to demanding timescales.

• Experience of supporting or delivering changes to services, processes or ways of working, with an understanding of the effect change has on users and operational teams.

Desirable skills

• A recognised project management qualification or equivalent professional development, such as APM, PRINCE2 or an Agile project delivery qualification.

• Experience of delivering projects within government or another large and complex organisation.

• Experience of digital, information management, security, operational or service transformation projects.

• Experience of supporting business cases, procurement or supplier management.

• Experience of using project and management information to support portfolio reporting, prioritisation or benefits management.

Application Process

This vacancy will be assessed using Success Profiles:

The Civil Service recruits using Success Profiles. For each role, we consider what candidates need to demonstrate to be successful.

A Success Profile is made up of 5 elements:

• behaviours - the actions and activities that people do which result in effective performance in a job

• strengths - the things we do regularly, do well and that motivate us

• ability - the aptitude or potential to perform to the required standard

• experience - the knowledge or mastery of an activity or subject gained through involvement in or exposure to it

• technical - the demonstration of specific professional skills, knowledge or qualifications

Not all the elements are relevant to every role and will vary by profession, level and type of role.

Success Profiles - GOV.UK

• CV (maximum 2 A4 pages)

• Personal statement of no more than 1,000 words (minimum Arial 11) explaining how you meet the essential criteria and requirements of the role.

• 250-word behaviour statement for each of the following behaviours:

o Communicating and Influencing (lead)

o Delivering at Pace

Completing your application :

Behaviour examples requires more than just information about what you did, it requires you to explain. There are many different approaches you could take to writing behaviours, such as the STAR, or the CAR method. As to which one you chose to use, it’s all down to your personal style of writing. Within the Civil Service, the most common approach is: The STAR method.

Using the STAR method, allows you to set the scene, show what and how you did and the overall outcome. The job holder (and later the interviewer) will use this method to gather all the relevant information about a specific capability that the job requires.

Situation - Describe the situation you found yourself in. You must describe a specific event or situation. Be sure to give enough detail for the job holder to understand.

  • Where are you?
  • Who was there with you?
  • What had happened?

Task - The job holder will want to understand what you tried to achieve from the situation you found yourself in.

  • What was the task that you had to complete and why?
  • What did you have to achieve?

Actions - What did you do? The job holder will be looking for information of what you did, how you did it and why. Keep the focus on you. What specific steps did you take and what was your contribution? Remember to include how you did it, and the behaviours you used. Try to use “I” rather than “we” to explain your actions that lead to the result. Be careful not to take credit of something that you did not do.

Results - Don’t be shy about taking credit for your behaviour. Quote specific facts and figures easily understandable.

  • What results did the actions produce?
  • What did you achieve through your actions and did you meet your goals?
  • Was it a successful outcome? If not what did you learn from the experience?

Keep the situation and task parts brief. Concentrate on the action and the result. If the result was not entirely successful describe what you learned from this and what you would do differently next time. Make sure you focus on your strengths.

Remember- if you are a school leaver or out of employment, and feel that you don’t have the experience to apply for this role then do this-

  • Make a list of your skills, strength and experience
  • Focus on your education/day-to-day life/extra-curricular activities such as team sports
  • Highlight anything that would help you perform in the job that you are applying for

title: Assistant Designer
description:
Be part of an amazing story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Assistant Designer begins their career on the Design Team at Macy’s, actively engaging in the process of learning the company culture, area, brand aesthetics, and principles. This role provides an opportunity to think, dream, and create, seeking designers who are visionaries and leaders. Macy’s values original design, fostering a supportive Design community that prioritizes innovation and teamwork.

What You Will Do

  • Develop an understanding and skills in researching category, trend, and customer preferences

  • Contribute to in-season design changes for the department and vendors

  • Collaborate closely with the people leader to meet deadlines and understand priority and workload expectations

  • Establish relationships and maintain regular communication with cross-functional partners throughout the development cycle
  • Learn on the job how to identify opportunities and develop an assortment
  • Demonstrate the ability to collaborate and achieve results with a desire to grow within the company and pursue a career at Macy’s
  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities

Skills You Will Need

Research Skills: Ability to develop an understanding and skills in researching category, trend, and customer preferences

Presentation Skills: Competency in preparing presentation materials and setting up for design-led meetings

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong skills for actively participating in cross-functional team meetings, summarizing action points for the manager, and collaborating closely with team leaders to meet deadlines

Technical Skills: Ability to create flat mechanical sketches for design development packages, work with Adobe and CLO programs for style, color, and pattern development, and participate in creating and distributing tech packages

Relationship Building: Establish relationships and maintain regular communication with cross-functional partners throughout the development cycle

Adaptability and Learning: Willingness to learn on the job, identify opportunities, and develop an assortment

Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, crucial for effective collaboration and achieving results

Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Excel, and Adobe Design programs

Color and Print Sense: Strong color sense and print sense, with the ability to view and differentiate the color spectrum

Who You Are

  • Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply.
    • Experience in retail or design internships preferred
  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today!

title: Sr Engineer - CENG, Electrical Projects, Steam & Gas Engineering
description:
The Senior Engineer, under general guidance, directs or performs electrical power engineering assignments of major size or complexity and makes independent decisions on engineering problems and methods. This is a power engineering role requiring deep expertise in electrical power systems analysis, equipment specification, and generating station design. The Senior Engineer performs load flow studies, short circuit analyses, protective relay coordination, cable and equipment sizing calculations, and power quality assessments for the companys steam and gas generating stations. The role demands thorough knowledge of generator ratings, transformer applications, switchgear, protective relaying, grounding systems, and their relationship to NERC, NPCC, and NYSRC reliability requirements.

Beyond technical analysis, this role carries full project engineering responsibility: managing budgets, schedules, scoping documents, vendor relationships, and purchase specifications from conception through commissioning. The Senior Engineer coordinates closely with Steam & Gas Engineering working groups, plant operations personnel, and external vendors to deliver safe, reliable, and code-compliant solutions. This position demands a proactive engineer who takes ownership, surfaces issues and ambiguity early, upholds design basis discipline, and is comfortable working in active power generation plant environments.

This position does not provide employment pursuant to the terms of a STEM OPT Training Plan.

Core Responsibilities
  • Performs load flow studies, short circuit analyses, and arc flash hazard assessments for generating station electrical systems, including medium-voltage and low-voltage distribution.
  • Conducts electrical equipment sizing calculations for cables, transformers, switchgear, motor starters, bus duct, and associated protective devices based on load demands, voltage drop limits, ambient conditions, and derating factors.
  • Develops and maintains one line diagrams, power system models, and coordination study documentation for generating station electrical distribution systems.
  • Evaluates generator capability curves, nameplate ratings, and operating limits; understands their relationship to NERC reliability standards including MOD-025 (real and reactive power verification), PRC-019 (relay-to-capability coordination), and PRC-024 (frequency/voltage ride through).
  • Specifies, evaluates, and oversees testing of electrical distribution equipment including transformers, breakers, surge arresters, UPSs, and protective relays.
  • Understands CT and PT applications, burden calculations, saturation characteristics, and the implications for metering and relay accuracy.
  • Reviews vendor calculations, test reports, and equipment submittals for technical accuracy and compliance with company engineering specifications and applicable codes (NEC, NFPA, IEEE, ANSI).
  • Develops scoping documents, technical specifications, and purchase specifications for electrical equipment and contractor services.
  • Serves as the primary liaison with vendors and contractors, managing procurement, reviewing bids, evaluating proposals, and overseeing contract deliverables.
  • Conducts technical reviews of engineering drawings, specifications, and vendor submittals, ensuring compliance with design standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinates with estimating, erection, testing, maintenance and engineering groups to support seamless project execution. Maintains accurate and up to date project documentation in company tracking systems (e.g., Engage), including status updates, resource loading, and financial reporting.
  • Partners with Steam & Gas Operations personnel (plant operators and maintenance staff) to understand operational needs, address field issues, and validate engineering solutions.
Required Education/Experience
  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering and eight (8) years of engineering related experience. Experience in electrical power engineering, with emphasis on power systems analysis, equipment specification, and generating station or heavy industrial facility design. Experience should be acceptable to NY State for P.E. examination eligibility. or
  • Master's Degree in Electrical or Power Systems Engineering and six (6) years of engineering related experience. Experience in electrical power engineering, with emphasis on power systems analysis, equipment specification, and generating station or heavy industrial facility design. Experience should be acceptable to NY State for P.E. examination eligibility.
Preferred Education/Experience
  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering and eight (8) years of engineering experience in electrical power engineering, with emphasis on power systems analysis, equipment specification, and generating station or heavy industrial facility design.
Relevant Work Experience
  • Demonstrated proficiency in performing load flow studies, short circuit analyses, arc flash assessments, and protective device coordination studies, required.
  • Hands-on experience with electrical equipment sizing calculations: cables (ampacity, voltage drop, conduit fill, derating), transformers (kVA/MVA sizing, impedance, tap selection), switchgear, and motor starters, required.
  • Strong working knowledge of protective relaying principles, including overcurrent, differential, distance, and generator protection schemes, and the ability to develop and review relay coordination studies and time-current curves, required.
  • Understanding of generator ratings, capability curves, excitation systems, and synchronization, and their relevance to NERC/NPCC/NYSRC reliability standards and compliance requirements, required.
  • Proficiency with power system analysis software (e.g., ETAP, SKM, EasyPower, or equivalent) for modeling, simulation, and coordination, required.
  • Working knowledge of applicable codes and standards: NEC, NFPA 70E, IEEE (C37 series, 80, 141, 242, 399, 551), ANSI, and NERC reliability standards applicable to generating stations, required.
  • Experience specifying and evaluating testing of power equipment: transformers (DGA, HiPot, turns ratio, winding resistance), breakers, surge arresters, CTs/PTs, and protective relays, required.
  • Understanding of grounding system design, ground fault protection, and step-and-touch potential analysis, required.
  • Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, and full project lifecycle activities in a utility or heavy industrial environment, required.
  • Experience with cross-discipline drawing verification and peer review processes; ability to reconcile information across multiple drawing sets (e.g., electrical, instrumentation, mechanical) to ensure field accuracy, required.
  • Experience with purchase specification development and vendor management for major electrical equipment (transformers, switchgear, generators, protective relays), preferred.
  • Direct experience supporting NERC compliance activities, including generator verification testing (MOD-025), relay-to-capability coordination (PRC-019), or reliability standards documentation, preferred.
  • Experience with medium-voltage switchgear design, specification, and commissioning (5 kV, 15 kV, or 27 kV class), preferred.
  • Familiarity with battery systems, DC distribution, UPS design, and emergency power supply systems in generating stations, preferred.
Skills and Abilities
  • Effective interpersonal skills
  • Develops and delivers effective presentations
  • Project Demonstrated project management skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to simultaneously handle multiple priorities
Licenses and Certifications
  • Driver's License Required
  • Professional Engineer (PE) Preferred
Physical Demands
  • Ability to respond to system emergencies
  • Able to work in all weather conditions, i.e. excessive heat and/or cold
  • Ability to climb ladders and stairs
  • Stand, walk, and climb ladders and stairs for the duration of the workday
  • Ability to travel to company locations to work on storm restoration and heat contingencies
  • Wear necessary Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), i.e. fire-retardant clothing and safety harnesses
Additional Physical Demands
  • The selected candidate will be assigned a System Emergency Assignment (i.e., an emergency response role) and will be expected to work non-business hours during emergencies, which may include nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Comfortable working in and around steam and gas power generation plants, including field visits and on-site engineering support.

Every role at CQC contributes to our mission. If you're looking for a new role in Technology that gives a true sense of meaning and purpose, then you've found it. Picture this

On the Project Delivery Fast Stream, you’ll develop professional skills to help deliver the most exciting projects happening in the UK.

The specific towns and cities depend on the department you are posted to and its office locations. The Fast Stream evolves continually, so postings can vary from year to year.

As an indication, in 2026 new fast streamers were posted to government offices in the following regions: Greater London, North East, North West, Scotland, South East, South West, West Midlands, Yorkshire and the Humber.

On occasion, some individuals may need to move location. We aim to align postings with your preferences whenever possible; however, final decisions must support our wider business needs. Please note that Fast Streamers cannot choose their department or their specific role.

As a Project Delivery fast streamer, you will enjoy an unprecedented scale and challenge across the work you are involved in. There are a wide variety of opportunities available to work on projects that deliver huge benefits and improvements to our society, from building hospitals and railways, to providing cutting-edge digital services. Joining the Project Delivery Fast Stream will give you the chance to build professional project skills whilst playing an active role in some of the most significant projects across the globe.

Work-based scenarios - This test measures interpersonal skills, utilising video based scenarios and you are required to assess the effectiveness of various responses.

title: Group Reservation Coordinator - JW Marriott Venice Resort & SPA | Season 2027
description:
Job Summary
The Group Reservation Coordinator manages the room-reservation administration for contracted groups, events and tour series. The role maintains accurate group blocks, rooming lists, ResLink and daily snapshots; supports individual guest requirements; and completes the rooms component of financial recaps. Working closely with Sales, Events, Reservations, Revenue and Finance, the coordinator protects inventory accuracy, strengthens forecasting and creates a clear, reliable experience for planners and guests.
Core Work Activities
• Create and maintain group room grids, rate codes and blocks from tentative stages (TE2) through definite status, and request NPC when required under the applicable process.
• Join sales-to-events handovers and confirm room-block structure, reservation method, key dates, attrition terms, payment arrangements and guest-administration requirements.
• Manage ResLink, rooming lists, daily snapshots, pickup and attrition tracking; add or assign rooms and accompanying guests as needed.
• Upload and validate rooming lists, resolve discrepancies and negative inventory, and coordinate changes with Reservations, Revenue, Sales and Events.
• Provide planner and guest support for pre- and post-stays, confirmations, visa-support letters, payment links and reservation questions within authorised procedures.
• Coordinate routing instructions, reservation alerts and self-payer arrangements with Events and retain the required payment backup.
• Review stop-sales information with Reservations and Revenue and share monthly need-date insights with Proactive Sales for GSO activity.
• Follow up on tentative blocks and forecasts each month, including direct contact with relevant planners or tour partners, to improve block accuracy and timely conversion to definite.
• Create and maintain tour-series records in SFA, OPERA and MARSHA/EMPOWER and keep supporting Excel and system records accurate and current.
• Complete the rooms section of group and event cost recaps and participate in Finance handovers; Events completes the food-and-beverage section.
• For tour series with food and beverage, coordinate the rooms recap and Finance handover with Events; for tours without food and beverage, manage the full recap directly with Finance.
• Monitor cut-off dates, pickup, wash and booking patterns and escalate material risks or discrepancies promptly to Sales, Revenue or Reservations leadership.
• Protect guest and payment information and follow all property, Marriott and applicable data-protection requirements.
Service and Coordination Responsibilities
• Provide accurate, timely and courteous support to planners and guests across the pre-arrival and post-stay journey.
• Maintain clear notes and audit-ready documentation so that Reservations, Events, Front Office and Finance can act confidently.
• Participate in departmental meetings and handovers relevant to group rooms, tour series, arrivals and financial follow-up.
• Identify recurring block, rooming-list or communication issues and suggest practical process improvements.
Candidate Profile
• High school diploma or equivalent; a qualification in Hospitality, Tourism, Business Administration or a related field is preferred.
• Relevant experience in hotel reservations, group housing, front office, sales administration or event support.
• Experience with OPERA and hotel reservation systems; knowledge of MARSHA/EMPOWER, ResLink, SFA and Excel is preferred.
• High level of accuracy when handling rooming lists, rates, dates, billing instructions and guest data.
• Confident written and verbal communication in English and Italian; additional languages are an advantage.
• Eligibility to work in Italy.
Core Competencies
• Reservations accuracy and inventory awareness
• Organisation and deadline management
• Guest and planner communication
• Systems discipline and data quality
• Financial-documentation accuracy
• Cross-functional coordination
• Confidentiality and attention to detail
Marriott Culture, Safety and Inclusion
• Model Marriott service values and create an environment in which associates feel welcomed, supported and accountable.
• Follow all company, property, safety, security, confidentiality and data-protection policies and procedures.
• Maintain a professional appearance and communicate clearly and respectfully with guests, clients, partners and colleagues.
• Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by leadership to support business needs.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

About the job

Job summary

We are MHCLG

Here at the Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government (MHCLG), we work on things that make a real difference to people’s lives. Whether it's through the homes we live in, the work of our local councils, or the communities we’re all part of, our work is at the top of the political agenda. We have ambitious and far-reaching outcomes to achieve this year so if you’re thinking of joining us, there’s never been a more exciting time.

The Service Delivery Manager will be part of our Operations Team within Elections Digital team at MHCLG. This team is responsible for the DES portfolio of electoral services. Our services include:

  • Register to vote
  • Apply for a proxy vote
  • Apply for a postal vote
  • Apply for photo ID to vote (called a ‘Voter Authority Certificate’)
  • Overseas Electors Renewals
  • A product we have built for electoral teams in Local Authorities to support electoral administration (EROP).

We have lots to do. We must continue to improve our existing services to meet the needs of our users, especially those of disabled and other marginalised users. We must also think strategically about the future, understanding what problems still exist and champion user-centred ways of working to approach these issues.

You will be embedded in the Operations team, and specifically within the technical branch of the team. Tou will have daily responsibility for the Electoral Registration Officer Portal, but also be expected to develop and maintain a good all-round knowledge of the technical architecture of the portfolio.

This role will involve working closely with the product team on continuous improvement to our existing services, especially the portal.

*The role will also focus on ensuring the portfolio has a strong and resilient cyber security posture, engaging with OGDs and specialists as required with the support of the Technical Delivery Lead.

Find out more about our Digital teams and what they are working on through our MHCLG Digital blog. Please note that MHCLG do not offer visa sponsorship and applicants will need a valid visa for the duration of your employment.

We’re looking for people with strong interpersonal skills who enjoy working in a demanding, high profile agile environment. We’re looking for people who are passionate about agile working, who care about technology and who know how to deliver high quality services without an over-reliance on using AI tools. We want people who believe that how you work is as important as what you deliver.

As a Service Delivery Manager, you will:

  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of the ERO Portal and its integrated systems and services, ensuring seamless functionality and optimal performance.
  • Work across product and delivery teams to identify opportunities for service enhancements, driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Act as a deputy for Delivery Leads when necessary, ensuring continuity of leadership and decision-making.
  • Ensure that operational and technical documentation evolves in line with service enhancements and procedural changes.
  • Identify and implement service optimizations to enhance efficiency, performance, and user satisfaction.
  • Manage a team of HEO and EO-level colleagues, providing guidance, support, and development to ensure effective performance.
  • Ability to prioritise and manage multiple incidents, ensuring timely resolution of issues and minimization of service disruptions.

Person specification

We are interested in people who have:

  • Proven experience in delivering digital projects and products, using agile methods.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with a wide base of stakeholders, such as Local Authorities and suppliers.
  • Ability to investigate problems in systems, processes and services and contribute to the implementation of remedies and preventative measures, including service improvements to make processes simpler and more efficient
  • Good written and verbal skills and a strong customer service ethos
  • Ability to communicate between the technical and non-technical
  • Ability to work independently, managing and prioritising tasks effectively Strong planning and organisation skills

Benefits

Alongside your salary of £45,773, Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government contributes £13,260 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

Behaviours , Experience , Strengths , Technical

title: Senior Analytics Manager, Generosity Experimentation
description:
THE POSITION

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

The Senior Manager, Generosity Experimentation will play a pivotal role in scaling our experimentation function within the Sportsbook team. You'll own the experimentation strategy and execution for Generosity, leading a small team of analysts while staying hands-on with key tests and insights. This role puts you at the center of how we learn and adapt. You'll work closely with business stakeholders to define what we should test, partner with our data science team to ensure we're following best practices, and most importantly, make sure every insight we uncover drives business decisions. You'll have the opportunity to be involved in key strategic initiatives that support FanDuel's overall growth.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN
Everyone on our team has a part to play

  • Define and prioritize the experimentation roadmap across our entire generosity portfolio, including investment mix, offer mix, loyalty program optimization, acquisition and other initiatives, making disciplined trade-offs to maximize learning and business impact.
  • Stay hands-on with key experiments, including those focused on generosity personalization. Proactively guide working teams (Commercial, Customer Marketing, Data Science) through design, execution and analysis of transformational experiments.
  • Own the feedback loop from experiment design to business action, ensuring insights are translated into stakeholder decisions. Partner with other analytics teams (generosity analytics, performance and insights) on continuous hypothesis development.
  • Manage and develop a team of analysts, coaching them on experimental design, stakeholder communication, and analytical rigor. Ensure that best practices and methodologies are applied to all generosity experiments, consulting on novel problems and ensuring we maintain statistical rigor without sacrificing speed.
  • Be a key stakeholder for experimentation tooling development. Articulate what our team needs from the platform, identifying gaps and requirements that will help us move faster and smarter.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations to leadership, ensuring experimentation insights directly inform strategy and business priorities.

THE STATS

What we’re looking for in our next teammate

  • Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in experimentation, analytics, commercial strategy, or similar quantitative roles, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership or senior individual contributor role.
  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science or a related field. Advanced degree a plus.
  • Proven track record of designing, executing, and analyzing experiments at scale, with demonstrated ability to drive business impact through data-driven approaches.
  • Strong knowledge of experimentation statistics. Experience with advanced experimental and quasi-experimental methods, such as synthetic controls, propensity matching and reinforcement learning methods.
  • Advanced proficiency with SQL, statistical programming languages (i.e., Python), data platforms (i.e., Databricks) and responsible use of AI.
  • Genuine passion for sports, sports betting, or the gaming industry. You understand what drives fan engagement and care deeply about delivering exceptional customer experiences.
  • Demonstrated excellence at people leadership, including hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing teams. You create psychological safety and foster a culture of curiosity and rigor.
  • Comfort shifting between hands-on work and strategic leadership. You can move fluidly between deep technical work like designing experiments and analyzing data, and high-level stakeholder communication.
  • Strong communication skills. You can present complex findings clearly to both technical and business audiences and drive alignment on priorities across teams.
  • A "can-do" attitude and bias toward action. You're comfortable getting into rooms, reaching out across teams, and doing whatever it takes to keep momentum.

ABOUT FANDUEL

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America’s #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry’s unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

PLAYER BENEFITS
We treat our team right

We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO & sick leave), annual bonus and long-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more - check out all our benefits here: FanDuel Total Rewards. *Benefits differ across location, role, and level.

FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, “We are One Team!”. As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. We believe FanDuel is strongest and best able to compete if all employees feel valued, respected, and included.

FanDuel is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please email Benefits@fanduel.com.

The applicable salary range for this position is $156,000 - $195,000 USD, which is dependent on a variety of factors including relevant experience, location, business needs and market demand. This role may offer the following benefits: medical, vision, and dental insurance; life insurance; disability insurance; a 401(k) matching program; among other employee benefits. This role may also be eligible for short-term or long-term incentive compensation, including, but not limited to, cash bonuses and stock program participation. This role includes paid personal time off and 14 paid company holidays. FanDuel offers paid sick time in accordance with all applicable state and federal laws.

title: Chief Construction Inspector - Stations & Facilities Const.
description:
The primary function of this position is to plan, manage, execute, direct, and/or supervise the activities of company inspectors, company contractors, and municipal, transit authority, or private contractors; that are performing various construction projects within company facilities, generating stations, and substations, or within franchised area such as public roadways, highway, or bridges. Ensure all work is done in strict compliance with all the applicable company specifications, standards and procedures, as well as all regulatory requirements. In addition, CCIs are responsible to properly maintain, protect, support the integrity of company facilities during construction projects, and ensure all work is completed within the specified schedule and budget. This position does not provide employment pursuant to the terms of a STEM OPT Training Plan. Provides oversight and leadership at multiple construction job sites and may be reassigned

to alternate locations based on business requirements.

Core Responsibilities
  • Supervise field personnel including union inspectors, General Utility Workers, and contractors, ensuring they understand and follow contract scope, drawings, and specifications.
  • Conduct and oversee field inspections to verify contractor compliance with safety protocols, NYC DOB Code, Code 753, and environmental regulations.
  • Lead safety and training initiatives such as Job Briefings, JSSEs, toolbox talks, and on-the-job training; maintain a Zero Harm environment.
  • Manage project documentation including daily logs, schedules, RFIs, submittals, meeting minutes, photos, and certifications.
  • Coordinate and monitor project costs including budgeting, forecasting, payments, lien releases, and cash flow.
  • Handle contractor oversight through systems like COS, manage change orders, and ensure compliance with internal manuals (CAM, ICM).
  • Facilitate communication with stakeholders, contractors, engineers, architects, and external agencies to resolve issues and maintain project progress.
  • Ensure proper inspections and closeout by coordinating special and 3rd-party inspections, reviewing punch lists, warranties, and final documentation.
  • Respond to emergencies and damages including environmental, safety, and system-wide events; prepare investigation reports as needed.
  • Maintain certifications and qualifications such as OSHA, CPR, NY State Project Monitor, and others required for field supervision and safety compliance.
  • Provides oversight and leadership at multiple construction job sites and may be reassigned to alternate locations based on business requirements.
Required Education/Experience
  • Bachelor's Degree and 2 years field construction, construction management, project management or site superintendent experience. or
  • Associate's Degree and 5 years field construction, construction management, project management or site superintendent experience. or
  • High School Diploma/GED and 7 years field construction, construction management, project management or site superintendent experience.
Preferred Education/Experience
  • Bachelor's Degree Bachelor's degree in engineering, Construction Management, Construction Technology, or Project Management. and 2 years field construction, construction management, project management or site superintendent experience.
Relevant Work Experience
  • Fundamental background in construction management and be knowledgeable in electrical, mechanical, civil, chemical, construction or Operations, required.
  • Knowledge of NYC & NYS Construction Codes (Buildings, Highway, Water/Sewer, etc.), required.
  • Knowledge of safety and environmental procedures related to working in generating stations, substations, commercial facilities, public streets, tunnels, bridges, etc., required.
  • Knowledge of scheduling, project planning and coordination, required.
  • Knowledge of and ability to manage contract administration procedures, inspection and cost control, required.
  • Ability to interface with external agencies and customers, required.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, written, presentation and technical skills, required.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access Database), required.
  • Knowledge of industry standard construction, means, methods and safety, required.
  • Knowledge of subsurface infrastructure construction (water, sewer, electric, gas, etc.), required.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, contractors/vendors, and personnel at the same time, required.
  • Knowledge of NYS & NYC DOT rules, regulations and permits, Preferred.
  • OSHA 30, Preferred.
  • Proficiency and knowledge of ProjectWise, Auto-CAD, Micro-station, Microsoft Projects, Primavera, MAXIMO, and/or Oracle Work Management System, Preferred.
  • Engineer-In Training Certificate (EIT/FE), Preferred.
Licenses and Certifications
  • Driver's License Required
Additional Physical Demands
  • The selected candidate will be assigned a System Emergency Assignment (i.e., an emergency response role) and will be expected to work non-business hours during emergencies, which may include nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Must be able and willing to travel within Company service territory, as needed.
  • Ability to work in inclement weather and adverse conditions (i.e., excessive heat, cold, noise, confined spaces)
  • Stand, walk, lift, climb, bend, kneel, stoop, and/or reach for the duration of the workday
  • Use personal vehicle(s), and be able to transport, store, and secure company laptops and other job-related equipment in vehicle. Acknowledge that reimbursement for use of personal vehicle is available through the company mileage procedure
  • Provides oversight and leadership at multiple construction job sites and may be reassigned to alternate locations based on business requirements.
  • Ability to be approved to wear and use either a full or half-face respirator, without facial hair or other conditions that may interfere with the seal, in accordance with OSHA regulations.

title: Environmental Service Assoc. 1 - 40hrs
description:
The Environmental Services Associate I is responsible for maintaining a clean, safe, and sanitary environment throughout the hospital. This role supports infection prevention efforts and contributes to a positive patient, family, and staff experience by delivering high-quality environmental and support services across clinical and non-clinical areas. The role requires the ability to work in all areas of a healthcare environment, including exposure to sensitive situations and materials, and the availability to work weekends, holidays, and occasional on-call shifts, as needed.

Environmental Cleaning & Infection Prevention-60%

  • Clean and disinfect patient rooms, family spaces, offices, public areas, corridors, elevators, and stairwells in accordance with established protocols.
  • Perform discharge/terminal cleaning of patient and family areas, ensuring readiness for new occupants.
  • Collect, transport, and properly dispose of trash, recyclables, regulated medical waste, and sharps containers in compliance with safety standards.
  • Follow all infection prevention guidelines, including proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and approved cleaning agents.
  • Adhere to Safety Data Sheet (SDS) guidelines for safe handling and use of chemicals.
  • Maintain floors through vacuuming, carpet shampooing, and hard floor care (e.g., stripping, waxing, buffing).
  • Support cleanliness and safety of exterior areas by removing debris and maintaining entryways.
  • Assist with seasonal responsibilities, including snow removal, as needed.

Operational & Support Services-15%

  • Respond to routine and non-routine service requests in a timely and professional manner.
  • Deliver supplies, equipment, and other items (e.g., food, materials) to designated locations.
  • Assist with room and conference space set-ups, including moving furniture and equipment.

Equipment Maintenance & Safety-10%

  • Perform basic maintenance on environmental services equipment (e.g., replacing vacuum bags and belts, inspecting cords).
  • Identify and report equipment malfunctions, safety hazards, or facility maintenance concerns to appropriate departments.
  • Ensure equipment is used and stored safely in accordance with organizational standards.

Customer Service & Team Collaboration-10%

  • Demonstrate a courteous, responsive, and service-oriented approach in all interactions with patients, families, visitors, and staff.
  • Collaborate effectively with team members and other departments to support hospital operations.
  • Contribute to a positive team environment and participate in continuous improvement efforts.
  • Demonstrate awareness of the unique needs of pediatric patient populations (neonate through adolescence).
  • Interact with patients and families in a respectful, culturally sensitive, and professional manner.
  • Complete required training, in-services, and departmental meetings.

Performs Other Duties as Assigned.

Education and/or Experience Required:

  • Experience: 6 – 12 months of experience in environmental services, hospitality, or service field.

Education and/or Experience Preferred:

  • Education: High School Diploma, GED or equivalent.
  • Experience: Experience in a healthcare setting.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Knowledge:

  • Principles and practices of environmental cleaning and infection prevention in healthcare settings.
  • Safe handling and use of cleaning chemicals, including adherence to Safety Data Sheets (SDS).
  • Hospital policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements (e.g., OSHA, CDC, Joint Commission).
  • Basic operational maintenance of cleaning equipment (vacuums, floor machines, etc.).
  • Age-specific considerations and developmental needs of pediatric patients (neonate through adolescent).
  • Cultural awareness and sensitivity to patient and family diversity.

Skills:

  • Effective communication (verbal and written) with patients, families, staff, and supervisors.
  • Customer service skills with a focus on courtesy, responsiveness, and teamwork.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and standard operating procedures accurately.
  • Time management and organizational skills to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Basic troubleshooting and maintenance of environmental service equipment.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities, schedules, and environmental conditions.

Abilities:

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Ability to recognize potential safety hazards and take appropriate action.
  • Maintain attention to detail and quality while performing repetitive tasks.
  • Respond appropriately to emergency or non-routine situations, including patient-specific needs or environmental emergencies.
  • Maintain confidentiality and professionalism when interacting with patients, families, and staff.

title: Scientific Software Engineer
description:
• Job grade: Higher Executive Officer
  • Contract type: Permanent
  • Type of role: Engineering
  • Working pattern: Full-time
  • Number of jobs available: 1

Location

Exeter, South West England, EX1 3PB

About the job

Job summary

We’re looking for an exceptional Scientific Software Engineer to help us make a difference to our planet.

As our Scientific Software Engineer, the job may be suitable for hybrid working, which is where an employee works part of the week in the office and part of the week from home. This is a voluntary, non-contractual arrangement and the location advertised will be your contractual place of work.

Our opportunity is full time, 37 hours per week. Our people are at the heart of what we do and we'll do our best to agree a working pattern that works for everyone.

World changing work

From science to technology, from meteorology to management, and from planning to communication, our expertise helps us stand out as the authority on weather accuracy and climate prediction. We help individuals, industries and government to make better decisions to stay safe and thrive. This is the Met Office. This is who we are.

  • We’re a force for good - focusing on our environmental and social impact
  • We’re experts by nature - always learning and developing to do things better
  • We live and breathe it - putting our purpose at the heart of decision-making
  • We’re better together - understanding partnerships and inclusivity make us greater
  • We keep evolving - pushing boundaries to make tomorrow better for our customers

Your world of expertise

This role as a Scientific Software Engineer sits within the data-driven climate modelling project in the AI4Climate initiative at the Met Office Hadley Centre, where we are combining machine learning, deep learning data science, climate science, and high-performance computing to develop faster, more flexible approaches to climate predictions for downstream applications. We are looking for an exceptional SSE with strong data science and software engineering skills.

You will work at the intersection of AI and climate science, developing and explainable novel machine learning approaches for climate prediction and understanding how data-driven models (DDCMs) represent the Earth system. You will help advance scientific understanding of DDCMs and their role within future climate modelling systems.

You will join a multidisciplinary group of climate scientists, data scientists and software engineers, working closely with partners across the Met Office and internationally. You will help to join our pioneering work in DDCM as part of the Met Office AI4Climate initiative.

Job description

This is your chance to apply cutting-edge Ml and Deep Learning AI to one of the most urgent challenges of our time-understanding and predicting Earth’s changing weather in warming climate in the Earth System Data Science team.

  • Develop and apply machine learning and deep learning methods for climate-focused tasks such as projection, prediction and emulation.
  • Design, train and evaluate data-driven climate models using large-scale Earth system or simulated datasets.
  • Investigate the scientific behaviour, robustness, uncertainty and physical realism of DDCMs.
  • Develop new approaches for integrating physical understanding and machine learning methods.
  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks for assessing model skill and scientific credibility.
  • Contribute to research that advances understanding of Earth system processes through data-driven methods.
  • Work collaboratively with climate scientists, software engineers and internal and external research partners.
  • Contribute to the AI4Climate programme and wider Met Office strategy in data-driven modelling.
  • Publish high-impact research, collaborate internationally and help shape the scientific direction of a rapidly emerging field.

Person specification

  1. Lead Criteria: PhD, or equivalent knowledge and experience, in applying machine learning or deep learning to scientific, environmental or other complex datasets (Expert by Nature).
  2. Evidence of programming skills such as Python, ML-optimised data libraries and good quality assurance processes (Keep Evolving).
  3. Experience developing robust, maintainable and reproducible code in a scientific context.
  4. Ability to design experiments and evaluate methods to answer scientific questions.
  5. Understanding of statistical modelling, machine learning evaluation or uncertainty assessment.
  6. Experience working collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams (Better Together).
  7. Ability to communicate complex technical and scientific ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

The panel may perform a preliminary sift of the lead criteria as indicated above.

Benefits

Alongside your salary of £35,145, Met Office contributes £10,181 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

Our work is life-changing, often life-saving and always life-enhancing. The Met Office is Great Place to Work UK certified. We are also featured on their ‘Best Workplaces in Tech’ 2023, 2024 and 2025 lists, as well as their ’54 Best Workplaces for Women’ 2023 list.

As our Scientific Software Engineer, your total reward package will be up to £51,448 annually, which includes:

  • £35,145 base pay
  • An outstanding Civil Service pension, with an average employer contribution of 28.97%
  • Recruitment Retention Allowance (RRA) you will be paid £2,000 per annum as a market supplement to reflect the demand for your skills. Whilst in post, you will be paid this market driven allowance from April 2026 until March 2027 in your monthly pay
  • Annual Leave starting at 27.5 days (plus Bank Holidays) rising to 32.5 days (plus Bank Holidays) after 5 years and option to buy or sell up to 5 days per year of annual leave

Things you need to know

Artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance (opens in a new window) for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Selection process details

If you share our values, we’d love to hear from you! Click apply to begin your application. Please complete your career history and provide evidence against each of the essential criteria in the supporting statement questionnaire. We recommend candidates use the CARL method (Context, Action, Result and Learning) for presenting evidence of experience and skills.

Closing date 01/11/2026 at 23:59 with first stage interviews commencing from 23/11/2026. You will hear from us once the closing date has passed.

Using AI in your application

We welcome applications that use AI tools for support in drafting or refining, as long as they accurately reflect your own skills and experience. All hiring decisions at the Met Office are made by people, not AI. For more details, visit our approach to recruitment.

How we can help

If you have any questions or would like to discuss this opportunity further, please contact us at careers@metoffice.gov.uk.

If you’re considering applying and need support to do so, please get in touch. You can request adjustments either within your application or by contacting us. Should you be offered an interview, please be aware there may be a selection exercise which could include a presentation, written test or a scenario-based activity. About the job

Job summary

NS&I is one of the largest savings organisations in the UK with more than 24 million customers and over £240 billion invested. We are both a government department and an Executive Agency of the Chancellor of the Exchequer. Our origins can be traced back more than 150 years to 1861.

A small company with a big reach, we offer a range of benefits including flexible working, a 9-day fortnight scheme, a performance-related variable pay bonus, a generous pension scheme and great opportunities for development. We care for colleagues, respect one another, invest in our people and manage talent effectively.

We are currently working in a hybrid way with colleagues expected to work at their chosen office location for 40% of their working month.

Job description

The primary purpose of this role is to lead and facilitate the collaborative achievement of NS&I’s core business objectives by enabling suppliers to work together efficiently within NS&I’s multi-supplier outsourced model. This role will ensure ongoing alignment with the organisation’s strategic goals by providing proactive facilitation and effective leadership, to ensure that all involved parties contribute to the successful, effective, and seamless delivery of end-to-end services across NS&I’s ongoing transformation programme and critical operational functions.

Act as the Collaboration Manager under the contractual agreements with outsourced service partners to support the NS&I Director’s accountability as SIAM and enable the Suppliers to deliver their respective Service Agreements

  • Accountable for managing relationships with our strategic suppliers and fulfilling contractual obligations, acting with delegated authority to ensure compliance with the Collaboration Agreement.
  • Lead and embed collaborative practices across NS&I and strategic supplier partner organisations to ensure seamless delivery, proactive issue resolution, and alignment with transformation goals. Enable cross-functional coordination and collaborative fulfilment of dependencies and obligations through early engagement and joined-up planning.
  • Embed the NS&I Collaboration Agreement and lead behavioural alignment across delivery teams—ensuring collaborative practices reflect contractual expectations, support open engagement, and enable consistent partnership working.

Foster and facilitate a collaborative delivery approach across the multi-supplier environment for the transformation programme and operational services

  • Represent NS&I in governance forums, working groups, and Supplier Performance Review Boards—ensuring visibility and collaborative decision-making and challenge where necessary.
  • Drives cross-party collaboration and joined-up planning—supporting impact assessments, issue and incident resolution across managed service functions. Enables early engagement and collaborative fulfilment of dependencies and contractual obligations with Strategic Partners and Third-Party Providers.
  • Lead stakeholder engagement activities with suppliers to resolve emerging issues and support innovation, driving fair outcomes, continuous improvement and value co-creation.
  • Ensure compliance with collaboration obligations, managing dependencies, and cascading collaborative behaviours through the supply chain to support seamless service delivery and contractual commitments.
  • Promote a solution-first mindset, encouraging teams and suppliers to address and resolve issues promptly, then proactively address root causes to prevent repetition.

Create a collaborative culture focused on quality, resilience, continuous improvement and innovation to maximise the value from our partner expertise

  • Champion a customer-focused culture by empowering teams, respecting roles, and fostering transparent collaboration—delivering seamless, end-to-end services through proactive resolution and shared success.
  • Working with Transformation, Enterprise Service Management and the suppliers to identify and address opportunities to improve processes and deliver objectives.
  • Intervenes in emerging collaboration issues at an early stage, mediating before escalation to the Director Team. Manages formal governance processes if disputes remain unresolved, ensuring timely resolution.

Work with Partners to agree practical multi-party continuity protocols, including plans in place to maintain contact with all stakeholders if normal channels fail. Take steps to ensure collaboration agreements remain effective during crises.

Location

MOD Abbey Wood, Bristol, BS34 8JH
BAE Systems, Barrow-in-Furness, LA14 1AF

About the job

Job summary

The Submarine Delivery Group (SDG) is a part of the Ministry of Defence responsible for the procurement, in-service support, and disposal of the UK’s nuclear submarines. Our work is of unparalleled strategic importance nationally and internationally, ensuring the security of the UK’s continuous at-sea nuclear deterrent (CASD), and delivering some of the most technically complex programmes in defence. At least one of four nuclear-armed submarines, supported by smaller attack submarines, is on patrol at all times: 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

At the SDG, we strive to Support, Deliver and Aspire and put our values at the heart of our recruitment process. We believe that everyone should feel comfortable to be themselves and be supported to do their best work. As part of a diverse and inclusive workforce, our team will find a community to belong to. We believe that, by celebrating different backgrounds and different perspectives, together we’ll achieve the extraordinary.

This position is advertised 37 hours per week.

This primary delivery location for this position is Bristol OR Barrow in Furness

Please note, due to the level of security, this role is reserved for UK nationals only.

Job description

The SSNA Programme Director provides senior leadership for the SSNA Programme they are accountable for the delivery of £8.4BN in contracts and responsible for driving delivery of the integrated SSNA Programme on behalf of the Alliance Managing Director. The SSNA Programme Director will be responsible for the day-to-day activities of the SSNA Programme. Responsible for building a strong relationship with and between BAE Systems, Rolls-Royce, Babcock and the SDG to ensure seamless coordination and communication. The successful post holder will be responsible for the delivery of the performance of the Programme for cost, risk, schedule and scope.

As Programme Director, you will shape programme strategy, support the development of integrated investment plans, and oversee the delivery of complex, multi‑billion‑pound activities that determine future production readiness. You will ensure alignment with wider SDG programmes, working closely with the Defence Nuclear Organisation and Industry Parties to integrate requirements, schedules and resources.

You will have a strong track record of leading complex, high risk programmes or portfolios, delivering in environments characterised by scale and external scrutiny. You will maintain and continuously improve programme governance, assurance and reporting arrangements ensuring clear oversight of risk, affordability and deliverability.

Building and managing relationships at senior levels across government and industry is central to the role. You will work closely with the Programme Directors of BAE Systems Submarines, Rolls‑Royce Submarines and Babcock International, ensuring that commercial and industrial decisions support MOD objectives. You will represent the programme in all forums as required and provide timely, evidence based advice to senior leaders including SPA MD, Director Generals and engage with His Majesty’s Treasury and other stakeholders as part of approvals and assurance processes.

The SSNA Programme Director leads a developing programme team of around 23 posts across Abbey Wood, Barrow-in-Furness and Derby. You will provide clear direction, build capability, and ensure cohesive delivery across infrastructure, commercial, workforce and supply‑chain workstreams.

This is a pivotal leadership role, requiring exceptional leadership, judgement and the ability to balance risk, cost and delivery pressures across a programme of national strategic importance. The successful candidate will play a defining part in delivering the future submarine programme successfully.

Overview: SSNA Programme Director

Accountable for the delivery of £8.4BN contract, responsible for driving delivery of the integrated SSNA Programme on behalf of the Alliance Managing Director. The SSNA Programme Director will be responsible for the day-to-day activities of the SSNA programme. Responsible for building a strong relationship with and between BAE Systems, Rolls-Royce, Babcock and the SDG to ensure seamless coordination and communication. Responsible for the Delivery of the performance of the Programme for cost, risk, schedule and scope.

Monitoring Performance of the Programme

  • Assuring the system of day-to-day scrutiny of SSNA programme performance, across all four partners (SDG, BAE Systems, Rolls-Royce and Babcock)
  • Designing policies and procedures for the assurance of the Programme, including reporting requirements and risk management
  • Providing a strategic programme overview across the areas of greatest uncertainty and risk and make programmatic decisions on recommendations made by the IPs and SDG teams
  • Supporting the Annual Budgeting Process to enable forecasting of how the SSNA programme is performing
  • Working with the Alliance Programme Controls Director and SSNA Financial Controller to ensure that quality information and advice is available to support programmatic decision-making
  • Building strong relationships with the SSNA programme teams in each of the Parties, to ensure that issues are escalated and resolved rapidly.

Proactive Risk and Opportunity Management

  • Promote a culture of proactive risk management and innovation. Challenge the Industry Partners (IPs) to actively identify risk and opportunity in their areas of scope
  • Ensure that continuous improvement and learning from experience in SSNA across other programmes is captured with the Programme Team, and applied to de-risk future delivery

Controlling the baseline for delivery

  • Set the Parties’ baseline for the Optimum programme, by challenging the bases of estimates, and assisting negotiation with Industry on pricing and the level of risk in contracts
  • Hold the Parties (including the SDA) to account for delivery against their baseline through facilitating formal Alliance Management Reviews, scrutinising the performance of Programme Directors from each Party for delivery of dependencies into the Programme
  • Producing analysis on the drivers of over/underperformance, and challenging any corrective plans submitted by the Programme Directors and challenging the parties on management of known risks/issues
  • Endorse whether the Parties in delivery have achieved relevant milestones in the Programme, and provide authorisation to proceed across production phases where appropriate and facilitate ‘top down’ reviews of Programme cost/schedule reduction, and support planning for future tranches not yet under contract
  • Managing the SSNA Programme Team Day-to-day management of the team
  • Ensure the Alliance Programme Team’s effectiveness and efficiency in their role, through recruitment, provision of training, etc
  • Resolve conflicts between recommendations / issues across more than one Programme Management’s scope of responsibility, to provide an integrated Programme-wide view
  • Manage performance of the Alliance Programme Team, including setting personal performance objectives
  • Managing the Interfaces and dependencies for the SSNA Programme Team Ensure that the Australia customer requirements are embedded into the Programme of Record
  • Deliver customer briefings to 2 & 3* Australian customer representatives enabling improved stakeholder collaborations
  • Manage the flow of information to SBM enabling coherence across the teams

Person specification

Please provide evidence of the following Essential Criteria in your Supporting Statement

Essential Criteria:

  • Ability to design, lead, and integrate large‑scale, highly complex programmes.
  • Proven track record of senior leadership in managing multidisciplinary teams across different locations, ensuring cohesive delivery across multiple workstreams.
  • Strong senior stakeholder management experience, building and managing relationships across both Government and industry with the ability to influence at executive level.
  • Budget management accountability for large scale spend
  • Proven experiencing of promoting a culture of proactive risk management and innovation
  • Ability to interpret and use complex data to inform strategic decisions
  • Proven track record of delivering major complex programmes, supply chain investment programmes, and workforce development initiatives.

Desirable Criteria:

  • Experience within Defence, maritime, nuclear, or complex regulated industrial sectors.
  • Knowledge of large‑scale facility expansion or modernisation in heavy engineering or manufacturing.
  • Experience of working with government approvals, assurance frameworks, and business‑case processes for major programmes.
  • Experience working with overseas government or industry partners on shared capability or production challenges.
  • A Chartered Project Manager or have a willingness to complete early in tenure.

Benefits

Alongside your salary of £86,000, Ministry of Defence contributes £24,914 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).
  • Learning and development tailored to your role
  • An environment with flexible working options
  • A culture encouraging inclusion and diversity
  • A Civil Service pension with an employer contribution of 28.97%
  • Discover My Benefits: Please follow the link to visit the Discover My Benefits site which showcases the benefits and discounts offered when working as a civilian for the MOD :

Things you need to know

Artificial intelligence

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance (opens in a new window) for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

To apply for this role please provide your CV and personal statement through the application steps on the CS jobs website.

All applications must include the following:

  • A CV, please complete the sections provided on the CS jobs application page. Please ensure you have provided reasons for any gaps within the last two years.
  • A separate Supporting Statement (1250 word limit) providing clear evidence of how you meet the Essential Criteria laid out in the Person Specification

Shortlisting

Assessment

Candidates shortlisted will be invited to an interview which will include the requirement to prepare a presentation for which they will normally be given at least one week’s notice of the subject.

Full details of the assessment process will be made available to shortlisted candidates.

Further Information:

To be considered for this role, qualifications and/or memberships detailed must be held in full, prior to submitting your application.

This role does not meet that category, and we will not sponsor a visa. It is therefore NOT open to applications from those who will require sponsorship under the points-based system.

    Should you apply for this role and be found to require sponsorship, your application will be rejected, and any provisional offer of employment withdrawn.
